dogecoin.text: #Cryptocurrency is digital cash. If I give my mom 100 dollars, the government doesn't know about it or tax it until she spends it. I should be able to use my #dogecoin the same way.  Right?
@Mintmobile Hey @VancityReynolds, can we pay you in #dogecoin? I'm asking for some friends. -> #dogearmy

@BillyM2k @realDogecoinOG Why don't you guys just talk on the phone and get to know each other a little? It seems you guys are both on the side of #dogecoin succeeding and thriving. No one needs to know what you say. Just fix it already.
